## Data Preparation

Two samples are analysed:

- **Main sample** (`data_participants.csv`): all registered exclusion criteria except the space bar check (see the cleaning report).
- **Fully registered sample** (`data_participants_registered.csv`): all registered exclusion criteria, including the space bar check, and no unregistered preprocessing.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggdist)
library(ggside)
library(easystats)
library(patchwork)
library(psych)

set.seed(3)

prepare_ig <- function(data) {
  data |>
    mutate(
        Block = as.factor(Block),
        Illusion_Effect = fct_relevel(as.factor(Illusion_Effect), "Incongruent", "Congruent"),
        Response_Correct = as.factor(Response_Correct)
    )
}

data_ppt <- read.csv("../data/data_participants.csv")
data_ig <- read.csv("../data/data_illusion.csv") |> prepare_ig()

data_ppt_reg <- read.csv("../data/data_participants_registered.csv")
data_ig_reg <- read.csv("../data/data_illusion_registered.csv") |> prepare_ig()
```



## PCS Score

### Computation

Mean subjective scale responses for item 4 (Taste) and item 10 (Post-session suggestion) are each generated from the combination of two responses which require processing prior to generating an overall subjective score.
The subjective score for item 4 is the mean of the responses to the (a)‘sour’ and (b)‘sweet’ sub-scales for the taste suggestion.
The subjective score for item 10 is the geometric mean (the square root of the product) of the responses to the (a) ‘urge’ and (b) ‘amnesia’ sub-scales for the post-session suggestion.

```{r}
pcs_items <- c("pcs_handslow", "pcs_mosquito", "pcs_magnetichands", "pcs_armrigidity", "pcs_tastescore", "pcs_postsessionsuggetsion", "pcs_armimmobile", "pcs_music", "pcs_negativehallucination", "pcs_amnesia")

compute_pcs <- function(data) {
  data$pcs_tastescore <- rowMeans(data[grepl("taste", names(data))])
  data$pcs_postsessionsuggetsion <- sqrt(data$pcs_urgepress * data$pcs_memorypress)
  data$PCS_Score <- rowMeans(data[, pcs_items], na.rm = TRUE)
  data
}

data_ppt <- compute_pcs(data_ppt)
data_ppt_reg <- compute_pcs(data_ppt_reg)
```



## Illusion Game Scores

### Computation

Scores are computed (1) for each illusion strength (Congruent, Mild, Strong) and difficulty (Easy, Hard) combination; (2) collapsing Mild and Strong ("Incongruent"); (3) collapsing Easy and Hard ("General"); and (4) collapsing both.

```{r}
compute_scores <- function(data_ig) {
  # Full stratification
  scores <- data_ig |>
      summarize(
          ErrorRate = sum(Error) / n(),
          IES = mean(RT[Response_Correct == "true"] / mean(Response_Correct == "true")),
          .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Condition_Illusion", "Condition_Difficulty")
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
          names_from = c("Illusion_Type", "Condition_Illusion", "Condition_Difficulty"),
          values_from = c("ErrorRate", "IES")
      )

  # Collapse Mild and Strong
  scores_incongruent <- data_ig |>
      filter(Condition_Illusion != "Congruent") |>
      summarize(
          ErrorRate = sum(Error) / n(),
          IES = mean(RT[Response_Correct == "true"] / mean(Response_Correct == "true")),
          .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Condition_Difficulty")
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
          names_from = c("Illusion_Type", "Condition_Difficulty"),
          values_from = c("ErrorRate", "IES")
      )
  names(scores_incongruent) <- str_replace_all(names(scores_incongruent), "_Hard", "_Incongruent_Hard")
  names(scores_incongruent) <- str_replace_all(names(scores_incongruent), "_Easy", "_Incongruent_Easy")
  scores <- full_join(scores, scores_incongruent, by = "Participant")

  # Collapse Easy and Hard
  scores_general <- data_ig |>
      summarize(
          ErrorRate = sum(Error) / n(),
          IES = mean(RT[Response_Correct == "true"] / mean(Response_Correct == "true")),
          .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Condition_Illusion")
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
          names_from = c("Illusion_Type", "Condition_Illusion"),
          values_from = c("ErrorRate", "IES")
      ) |>
    data_addsuffix(select=-Participant, pattern = "_General")
  scores <- full_join(scores, scores_general, by = "Participant")

  # Collapse both
  scores_incongruent_general <- data_ig |>
      filter(Condition_Illusion != "Congruent") |>
      summarize(
          ErrorRate = sum(Error) / n(),
          IES = mean(RT[Response_Correct == "true"] / mean(Response_Correct == "true")),
          .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type")
      ) |>
      pivot_wider(
          names_from = c("Illusion_Type"),
          values_from = c("ErrorRate", "IES")
      ) |>
     data_addsuffix(select=-Participant, pattern = "_Incongruent_General")
  full_join(scores, scores_incongruent_general, by = "Participant")
}

ig_scores <- compute_scores(data_ig)
ig_scores_reg <- compute_scores(data_ig_reg)
```

### Unregistered Analysis

Two main analyses are reported:

- **Fully registered analysis** (`ig_scores_reg`): all registered exclusion criteria, and no unregistered step.
- **Unregistered analysis** (`ig_scores_unreg`): all registered criteria except the space bar check, plus two unregistered exclusions: (1) trials with RT < 0.2 s or > 5 s are removed; and (2) participants whose congruent error rate for a given illusion lies above the 97.5% highest density interval (HDI) of its distribution are excluded for that illusion (likely misunderstanding of the instructions, i.e., high error rates where the illusion makes the task easier).

`ig_scores` (all registered criteria except the space bar check, and no other deviation) is used to isolate the effect of the space bar check.

#### Trial-Level RT Filter (unregistered)

```{r}
ig_scores_trialfilter <- compute_scores(filter(data_ig, !RT_Outlier))
```

#### HDI Exclusion (unregistered)

The HDI exclusion is computed on the trial-filtered scores. Two versions are computed: (1) **congruent upper tail only**, used in the unregistered analysis; and (2) the **two-sided** procedure used in the initial submission (both tails of the congruent and incongruent error rates), reported as a sensitivity analysis only.

```{r}
hdi_flag <- function(scores, mode = c("congruent_upper", "two_sided")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  conds <- if (mode == "two_sided") c("Congruent", "Incongruent") else "Congruent"
  flags <- list()
  breakdown <- data.frame()
  for (illu in c("MullerLyer", "Ebbinghaus", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
    flagged <- c()
    for (cond in conds) {
      x <- scores[[paste0("ErrorRate_", illu, "_", cond, "_General")]]
      bounds <- bayestestR::hdi(na.omit(x), ci = 0.975)
      above <- scores$Participant[!is.na(x) & x > bounds$CI_high]
      below <- if (mode == "two_sided") scores$Participant[!is.na(x) & x < bounds$CI_low] else c()
      missing <- if (mode == "two_sided") scores$Participant[is.na(x)] else c()
      flagged <- c(flagged, above, below, missing)
      breakdown <- rbind(breakdown, data.frame(
        Illusion = illu, Condition = cond, HDI_low = bounds$CI_low, HDI_high = bounds$CI_high,
        n_above = length(above), n_below = length(below)
      ))
    }
    flags[[illu]] <- unique(flagged)
  }
  list(flags = flags, breakdown = breakdown)
}

apply_flags <- function(scores, flags) {
  for (illu in names(flags)) {
    scores[scores$Participant %in% flags[[illu]], str_detect(names(scores), illu)] <- NA
  }
  scores
}

hdi_cong <- hdi_flag(ig_scores_trialfilter, "congruent_upper")
hdi_two <- hdi_flag(ig_scores_trialfilter, "two_sided")

hdi_two$breakdown |>
  format_table() |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header("97.5% HDI bounds and number of participants flagged in each tail")

data.frame(
  Illusion = names(hdi_cong$flags),
  Congruent_Upper = sapply(hdi_cong$flags, length),
  Two_Sided = sapply(hdi_two$flags, length)
) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header("Number of participants excluded per illusion")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 8

vars <- names(ig_scores_trialfilter)[str_detect(names(ig_scores_trialfilter), "ErrorRate_.*_(Congruent|Incongruent)_General")]
ps <- list()
for (var in vars) {
  bounds <- bayestestR::hdi(na.omit(ig_scores_trialfilter[[var]]), ci = 0.975)
  ps[[var]] <- ggplot(ig_scores_trialfilter, aes(x = !!as.name(var))) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.015) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(bounds$CI_low, bounds$CI_high), color = "red") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
    ggtitle(paste("97.5% HDI for", var)) +
    theme_minimal()
}
wrap_plots(ps)
```

#### Unregistered Scores and Sensitivity Versions

`make_unreg()` builds the unregistered scores from a trial-level dataset, with each deviation switchable, so that each deviation can be removed one at a time (sensitivity analyses).

```{r}
make_unreg <- function(data, trial_filter = TRUE, hdi = c("congruent_upper", "two_sided", "none")) {
  hdi <- match.arg(hdi)
  if (trial_filter) data <- filter(data, !RT_Outlier)
  scores <- compute_scores(data)
  if (hdi != "none") scores <- apply_flags(scores, hdi_flag(scores, hdi)$flags)
  scores
}

ig_scores_unreg <- make_unreg(data_ig)

# Block-wise RT rule (initial submission): the block-specific rule, registered for error rates
# only, also applied to the RT criterion. Approximate, as participants excluded by the
# registered (participant-level) RT rule are not in the data.
data_ig_rtblock <- data_ig |>
  filter(!Participant %in% data_ppt$Participant[data_ppt$IG_Outlier_RTBlock_Full]) |>
  filter(!((Block == "B") & (Participant %in% data_ppt$Participant[data_ppt$IG_Outlier_RTBlock_Half])))

unreg_versions <- list(
  "Unregistered without the trial-level RT filter" = make_unreg(data_ig, trial_filter = FALSE),
  "Unregistered without the HDI exclusion" = make_unreg(data_ig, hdi = "none"),
  "Unregistered with the two-sided HDI exclusion (initial submission)" = make_unreg(data_ig, hdi = "two_sided"),
  "Unregistered with the block-wise RT rule (initial submission)" = make_unreg(data_ig_rtblock)
)

data.frame(
  Illusion = c("MullerLyer", "Ebbinghaus", "VerticalHorizontal"),
  N_Unregistered = sapply(c("MullerLyer", "Ebbinghaus", "VerticalHorizontal"),
                          function(illu) sum(!is.na(ig_scores_unreg[[paste0("ErrorRate_", illu, "_Incongruent_General")]])))
) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header("Number of participants per illusion in the unregistered analysis")
```

### Should we collapse across Mild and Strong, and Easy and Hard?

Following the registered protocol, Bayesian correlations are computed between the Mild and Strong conditions for each illusion and outcome. If the correlation is above .50, the two conditions are collapsed (i.e., the registered test uses the "Incongruent" score); otherwise they are analysed separately. The tables below show the unregistered analysis; the decision itself is made separately for each analysis (see *Registered Decision*).

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Mild vs. Strong


```{r}
corrs <- data.frame()
for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {
    for (ill_type in c("Ebbinghaus", "MullerLyer", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
       for (dif in c("Easy", "Hard")) {

         corrs <- correlation::correlation(
                ig_scores_unreg[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type,"_Mild", "_", dif )],
                ig_scores_unreg[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Strong", "_", dif )],
                bayesian = TRUE
            ) |>
                mutate(Illusion = ill_type,
                       Outcome = outcome) |>
                rbind(corrs)
        }
    }
}

corrs2 <- data.frame()
for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {
    for (ill_type in c("Ebbinghaus", "MullerLyer", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
            corrs2 <- correlation::correlation(
                ig_scores_unreg[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Mild_General")],
                ig_scores_unreg[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Strong_General")],
                bayesian = TRUE
            ) |>
                mutate(Illusion = ill_type,
                       Outcome = outcome) |>
                rbind(corrs2)
        }
}



print_corrs <- function(t) {
  arrange(t, Illusion, Outcome, desc(rho)) |>
    mutate(Parameter1 = str_replace(Parameter1, "ErrorRate_|IES_", ""),
           Parameter1 = str_replace(Parameter1, paste0(Illusion, "_"), ""),
           Parameter2 = str_replace(Parameter2, "ErrorRate_|IES_", ""),
           Parameter2 = str_replace(Parameter2, paste0(Illusion, "_"), "")) |>
    datawizard::data_reorder(c("Illusion", "Outcome")) |>
    format_table() |>
    mutate(rho = as.numeric(rho)) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::data_color(
        columns = rho,
        fn = function(x) dplyr::case_when(
          x >= 0.5  ~ "lightgreen",
          .default   = "#ffabab"
        )
      )
}

print_corrs(rbind(corrs, corrs2))
```

```{r}
corrs3 <- data.frame()
for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {

        for (cond in c("Congruent", "Mild", "Strong")) {

print_corrs(rbind(corrs3))
```

#### Registered Decision

The decision uses the sample correlation (r) so that it is deterministic; the Bayesian estimates above are virtually identical.

```{r}
collapse_decision <- function(scores) {
  out <- data.frame()
  for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {
    for (ill_type in c("Ebbinghaus", "MullerLyer", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
      r <- cor(scores[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Mild_General")]],
               scores[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_Strong_General")]],
               use = "complete.obs")
      out <- rbind(out, data.frame(Outcome = outcome, Illusion = ill_type, r = r, Collapse = r > 0.5))
    }
  }
  out
}

registered_vars <- function(decision) {
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(decision)), function(i) {
    if (decision$Collapse[i]) {
      paste0(decision$Outcome[i], "_", decision$Illusion[i], "_Incongruent_General")
    } else {
      paste0(decision$Outcome[i], "_", decision$Illusion[i], c("_Mild_General", "_Strong_General"))
    }
  }))
}

analysis_scores <- c(
  list(
    "Fully registered" = ig_scores_reg,
    "Unregistered" = ig_scores_unreg,
    "Registered criteria without the space bar check (no other deviation)" = ig_scores
  ),
  unreg_versions
)

decisions <- lapply(analysis_scores, collapse_decision)

collapse_table <- bind_rows(decisions, .id = "Analysis")
saveRDS(collapse_table, "figures/table_collapse.rds")

collapse_table |>
  format_table() |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Analysis")
```

:::




#### Manipulation Check

Evidence (BF > 3) for differences between the Congruent and Mild and the Mild and Strong groups is taken as evidence that illusions functioned as intended (unregistered analysis).

```{r}
ttests <- data.frame()
for (outcome in c("ErrorRate", "IES")) {
    for (ill_type in c("Ebbinghaus", "MullerLyer", "VerticalHorizontal")) {
        for (cond in c("Congruent", "Mild")) {
            x1 <- ig_scores_unreg[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_", cond, "_General")]]
            if (cond == "Congruent") {
                x2 <- ig_scores_unreg[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_", "Mild_General")]]
            } else {
                x2 <- ig_scores_unreg[[paste0(outcome, "_", ill_type, "_", "Strong_General")]]
            }

            complete <- complete.cases(x1, x2)
            x1 <- x1[complete]
            x2 <- x2[complete]

            if (length(x1) < 2) {
                message(paste("Skipping:", outcome, ill_type, cond, "- not enough observations"))
                next
            }

            ttests <- BayesFactor::ttestBF(x = x1, y = x2, paired = TRUE) |>
                parameters::parameters() |>
                mutate(
                    Outcome = outcome,
                    Illusion_Type = ill_type,
                    Condition_Illusion = cond
                ) |>
                rbind(ttests)
        }
    }
}

ttests |>
    select(Illusion_Type, Condition_Illusion, Outcome, Median, BF) |>
    arrange(Illusion_Type, Condition_Illusion, Outcome) |>
    format_table() |>
    gt::gt()
```

#### Space Bar Check

The space bar task is the behavioural component of PCS item 10 (post-session suggestion): participants are told that they will press the space bar six times *and will forget having been told to do so*. If failing the check reflects a response to the amnesia suggestion rather than inattention, participants who did not press should report more amnesia for the instruction, and should not score lower on the other PCS items. The comparison score excludes item 10, which is computed from the urge and amnesia ratings.

```{r}
data_ppt$PCS_Score_NoItem10 <- rowMeans(data_ppt[, setdiff(pcs_items, "pcs_postsessionsuggetsion")], na.rm = TRUE)

table(Presses = data_ppt$pcs_press)

press_table <- data_ppt |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    Zero_Presses = sum(pcs_press == 0),
    Urge = mean(pcs_urgepress),
    Amnesia = mean(pcs_memorypress),
    PCS_OtherItems_Mean = mean(PCS_Score_NoItem10),
    PCS_OtherItems_SD = sd(PCS_Score_NoItem10),
    .by = PCS_Outlier_Press
  )
saveRDS(press_table, "figures/table_spacebar.rds")

press_table |>
  format_table() |>
  gt::gt()

bf_press <- BayesFactor::ttestBF(
  formula = PCS_Score_NoItem10 ~ PCS_Outlier_Press,
  data = mutate(data_ppt, PCS_Outlier_Press = as.factor(PCS_Outlier_Press))
)
bf_press
```

```{r}
ggsave("figures/fig_traits_distribution.png", width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

## Correlations

The fully registered analysis includes `r nrow(data_ppt_reg)` participants. The unregistered analysis includes `r report::report_participants(data_ppt, age="Age", sex="Sex", education="Education")`, for a total trial number of `r sum(!data_ig$RT_Outlier)` after removing extreme trials (and minus participants excluded per illusion by the HDI exclusion).

Bayesian correlations use the *BayesFactor* medium prior (r-scale = 1/3), as registered. BF~10~ ≤ 1/3 is interpreted as evidence for the null (H0), BF~10~ ≥ 3 as evidence for a relationship (H1), and values in between as inconclusive.

```{r}
make_cor <- function(data, scores) {
  features <- merge(scores, data[c("Participant", "PCS_Score", "PID5_Psychoticism")])

  correlation::correlation(
    dplyr::select(features, -Participant, -PCS_Score, -PID5_Psychoticism),
    dplyr::select(features, PCS_Score, PID5_Psychoticism),
    bayesian = TRUE,
    bayesian_prior = "medium" # r-scale = 1/3 in BayesFactor::correlationBF()
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Evidence = dplyr::case_when(
      BF <= 1/3 ~ "H0",
      BF >= 3 ~ "H1",
      .default = "Inconclusive"
    ))
}

cor_table <- function(rez) {
  rez |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(BF)) |>
    format_table() |>
    dplyr::mutate(BF = as.numeric(BF),
                  Parameter2 = str_remove_all(Parameter2, "_Score|PID5_")) |>
    dplyr::select(-Prior, -Method, -`% in ROPE`) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::data_color(
      columns = BF,
      fn = function(bf) dplyr::case_when(
        bf >= 10   ~ "green",
        bf >= 3    ~ "lightgreen",
        bf <= 1/10 ~ "red",
        bf <= 1/3  ~ "#ffabab",
        .default   = "white"
      )
    )
}

rez <- lapply(names(analysis_scores), function(a) {
  make_cor(if (a == "Fully registered") data_ppt_reg else data_ppt, analysis_scores[[a]])
})
names(rez) <- names(analysis_scores)
```

### Registered Tests

The registered tests are the correlations between each trait and each illusion-sensitivity score, where Mild and Strong are collapsed or kept separate according to the registered decision rule (see above).

```{r}
registered_tests <- function(rez, vars) {
  rez |>
    filter(Parameter1 %in% vars) |>
    separate(Parameter1, into = c("Outcome", "Illusion", "Condition", "Difficulty"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      Trait = ifelse(Parameter2 == "PCS_Score", "PCS", "Psychoticism"),
      Outcome = recode(Outcome, "ErrorRate" = "Error rate", "IES" = "IES"),
      Illusion = recode(Illusion, "MullerLyer" = "Müller-Lyer", "VerticalHorizontal" = "Vertical–Horizontal"),
      Condition = recode(Condition, "Incongruent" = "Mild + Strong")
    ) |>
    select(Trait, Outcome, Illusion, Condition, rho, CI_low, CI_high, BF, n_Obs, Evidence) |>
    arrange(Trait, Outcome, Illusion, Condition)
}

tests <- lapply(names(rez), function(a) registered_tests(rez[[a]], registered_vars(decisions[[a]])))
names(tests) <- names(rez)

saveRDS(tests[["Fully registered"]], "figures/table_correlations_registered.rds")
saveRDS(tests[["Unregistered"]], "figures/table_correlations_unregistered.rds")

bind_rows(tests[c("Fully registered", "Unregistered")], .id = "Analysis") |>
  mutate(
    rho = insight::format_value(rho, zap_small = TRUE),
    `95% CI` = insight::format_ci(CI_low, CI_high, ci = NULL),
    BF = insight::format_bf(BF, name = NULL)
  ) |>
  select(Analysis, Trait, Outcome, Illusion, Condition, rho, `95% CI`, BF, n = n_Obs, Evidence) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Analysis")
```

### Sensitivity Analyses

Number of registered tests supporting the null / inconclusive / supporting a relationship, for each version of the analysis. The rows after the two main analyses remove (or replace) one deviation at a time from the unregistered analysis. The last row keeps Mild and Strong separate for all scores in the unregistered analysis (exploratory, as in the initial submission).

```{r}
summarise_tests <- function(t) {
  t |>
    summarize(
      Result = paste0(sum(Evidence == "H0"), " / ", sum(Evidence == "Inconclusive"), " / ", sum(Evidence == "H1")),
      .by = c(Trait, Outcome)
    ) |>
    mutate(Column = paste(Trait, "×", Outcome)) |>
    select(Column, Result) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Column, values_from = Result) |>
    mutate(N = paste(unique(range(t$n_Obs)), collapse = "–"), .before = 1)
}

all_mildstrong <- names(ig_scores_unreg)[str_detect(names(ig_scores_unreg), "_(Mild|Strong)_General$")]
tests[["Unregistered, Mild and Strong not collapsed (exploratory)"]] <- registered_tests(rez[["Unregistered"]], all_mildstrong)

sensitivity_table <- bind_rows(lapply(tests, summarise_tests), .id = "Analysis")
saveRDS(sensitivity_table, "figures/table_sensitivity.rds")

sensitivity_table |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_source_note("Cells: number of tests with BF10 ≤ 1/3 (H0) / inconclusive / BF10 ≥ 3 (H1).")
```

### Correlations

```{r fig1}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 11
#| dpi: 300

plot_cor <- function(rez, title) {
  rez |>
    filter(str_detect(Parameter1, "_General$")) |>
    mutate(Trait = ifelse(Parameter2 == "PCS_Score", "Phenomenological Control", "Psychoticism")) |>
    separate(Parameter1, into = c("Measure", "Illusion", "Condition", "Difficulty"), sep = "_") |>
    mutate(Measure = recode(Measure, "ErrorRate" = "Error rate (primary)", "IES" = "IES (secondary)"),
           Illusion = recode(Illusion, "MullerLyer" = "Müller-Lyer", "VerticalHorizontal" = "Vertical–Horizontal"),
           Condition = recode(Condition, "Incongruent" = "Mild + Strong"),
           Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("Congruent", "Mild", "Strong", "Mild + Strong")),
           Label = format_bf(BF, stars = TRUE, protect_ratio = FALSE, digits = 2)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = rho, y = Illusion, color = Condition)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), size = 2.5) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0.5, label = Label), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
              hjust = 1, size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Congruent" = "#2196F3", "Mild" = "darkorange", "Strong" = "red", "Mild + Strong" = "#7B1FA2"),
                       breaks = c("Mild + Strong", "Strong", "Mild", "Congruent")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.3, 0.5), breaks = seq(-0.3, 0.3, by = 0.1),
                       labels = c("-.30", "-.20", "-.10", "0", ".10", ".20", ".30")) +
    facet_grid(Measure ~ Trait) +
    labs(x = "Correlation (posterior median and 95% credible interval)", y = NULL, color = "Illusion strength",
         title = title,
         caption = "Note. Labels show BF10. ° BF10 < 1/3 (evidence for the absence of a relationship); * BF10 > 3, ** BF10 > 10, *** BF10 > 30 (evidence for a relationship).\n'Mild + Strong' = Mild and Strong collapsed, as per the registered decision rule. The Congruent condition is not a measure of illusion sensitivity and is shown for reference only.") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "italic"),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
          panel.spacing.y = unit(2.5, "lines"))
}

ggsave("figures/fig_correlations_registered.png", p, width = 10, height = 11, dpi = 300)
```
